name: Vaso Medical Inc
old_description: VasoHealthcare provides professional sales representation service for capital medical equipment, with a specialty in the diagnostic imaging modalities for healthcare’s middle market, including independent hospitals, imaging centers, and multispecialty clinics across the continental U.S.  It has been partnering with General Electric Healthcare, a world leader in the medical imaging technology, since 2010.
about:
Vaso Corporation, formerly Vasomedical, Inc., is headquartered in Plainview, New York, with additional operations in Wuxi, China; Nashville, Tennessee; and Tampa, Florida. The public company operates across healthcare and information technology through three business units.

The VasoMedical unit designs, manufactures, sells, and services proprietary noninvasive monitoring, diagnostic, and therapeutic devices for cardiovascular disease, with engineering and production centered in its China-based facilities. VasoHealthcare has provided professional sales representation for General Electric Healthcare's diagnostic imaging modalities since 2010, targeting independent hospitals, imaging centers, and multispecialty clinics across the continental United States. VasoTechnology delivers managed IT systems, healthcare software solutions, and secure network connectivity services for enterprise and clinical customers.

The company serves the healthcare sector's middle market, including independent hospitals, imaging centers, and multispecialty clinics for imaging equipment sales, while its medical device unit reaches global markets through direct and partner channels. VasoTechnology supports enterprises and healthcare organizations with mission-critical applications, data storage, and security services.

Vaso Corporation emphasizes its cross-disciplinary expertise spanning medical devices, diagnostic imaging sales, and IT infrastructure, allowing it to address diverse clinical and enterprise needs.

name: Vaughan-Bassett Furniture
old_description: Vaughan-Bassett, the largest manufacturer of wooden residential furniture in the United States, is committed to their hometown of Galax, Virginia, just like we are committed to our hometown of Laurel, Mississippi.  We’ve partnered to create a cottage-inspired furniture line crafted by 600 American workers.  LMCo Bedroom Collections are now available in stores across the United States.
about:
Vaughan-Bassett Furniture has operated from Galax, Virginia, since its founding in 1919 by B.C. Vaughan and J.D. Bassett, Sr. What began as a small regional furniture company grew into the largest manufacturer of wooden adult bedroom furniture in the United States, remaining under the leadership of the Bassett family with John D. Bassett III serving as chairman.

The company employs more than 500 skilled artisans at its Galax factory, where they produce bedroom collections — including Dovetail, Tide & Timber, Cool Rustic, Bonanza, Pure Maple, and Maple Road — using wood solids and veneers such as oak, maple, cherry, ash, poplar, birch, beech, and pine. Modern manufacturing technology complements traditional craftsmanship, and the firm reports that 99 percent of its materials are sourced domestically.

Vaughan-Bassett sells through a dealer network to residential customers across the country. Its furniture is designed for real homes, meeting federal stability requirements under 16 CFR Part 1261 (ASTM F2057) for clothing storage units, and the company is a member of the American Home Furnishings Alliance.

The company's differentiation rests on a deliberate choice to keep production in America when much of the industry moved overseas. That commitment is documented in the bestselling book Factory Man. Vaughan-Bassett also operates a One for One sustainability program that has contributed more than six million tree seedlings to the Virginia Department of Forestry, and it sources 99 percent of its lumber within 500 miles of its factories.

name: Vault Foods
old_description: The U.S. FDA has approved Vault Foods™ solution as a processing aid, which means that it is so safe to use that labeling is not required.
about:
Vault Foods operates from its headquarters in Fair Oaks, Texas, with an SQF-certified treatment facility in Boerne, Texas. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company provides a food safety treatment service that uses an FDA-approved organic processing aid to reduce pathogens on foods such as nuts, seeds, and other packaged products. At its Boerne facility, the Neo-Pure system—developed in partnership with Agri-Neo—mists a proprietary biodegradable solution onto food surfaces and crevices, achieving a validated 5-log (≥99.999%) reduction of Salmonella, E. coli, and Listeria without heat, irradiation, or chemical gases. The process preserves the food's raw taste, smell, texture, and nutrition, and the solution biodegrades completely, leaving no residue and requiring no label declaration.

Vault Foods serves food processors and manufacturers in the nut, seed, and packaged-food sectors who need to extend shelf life while maintaining a "truly raw" product claim. Its treatment is designed to integrate into existing supply chains, offering certified freshness without altering the natural qualities of the food.

The company emphasizes that its processing aid is so safe the FDA does not require labeling, and that the organic, biodegradable solution differentiates it from thermal or chemical alternatives. The service was created to give food brands a way to achieve high-level pathogen reduction while keeping products raw and organic-compliant.

name: Venture Medical
old_description: Quality new, refurbished and used medical equipment for surgical centers, hospitals, and medical offices. Family-owned in Tampa, FL since 1999.
about:
Venture Medical ReQuip, Inc. is a family-owned medical equipment dealer based in Tampa, Florida. The business traces its roots to the mid-1980s when John Pritchard Sr., a firefighter, purchased a piece of medical equipment at a local auction and resold it for a profit. That single transaction grew into a company that has been family owned and operated since 1985, remaining independent of private equity or outside investors.

Today the company operates from an 18,000‑square‑foot facility in Tampa and maintains an online catalog of roughly 1,587 products across more than 30 categories. It supplies new, refurbished, and used medical equipment — including surgical tables, stretchers, patient monitors, defibrillators, infusion pumps, and OR stainless steel — and provides on‑site biomedical testing and repair services throughout the Tampa Bay area. Venture Medical also offers turn‑key ambulatory surgical center setups, short‑ and long‑term equipment rentals, and volume pricing for dealers, with every product shipping nationwide under a standard warranty.

The customer base spans ambulatory surgical centers, hospitals, and medical offices across the United States. Testimonials cite surgeons and facility directors in New Jersey and Florida who have relied on the company for everything from single‑item purchases to complete facility build‑outs.

Venture Medical says its differentiation lies in its family‑run values — honesty, integrity, and value — and its commitment to setting a benchmark for how pre‑owned equipment should be refurbished. The leadership emphasizes that independence from outside capital allows decisions focused on patient and staff safety rather than earnings pressure.

about:
Founded in 1998 in Stowe, Vermont, Vermont Electronics began as a technology services firm serving the Stowe area and broader Vermont region. The company traces its roots to over 48 years of combined technology experience among its principals, though individual founders are not named in public materials.

The firm specializes in custom design and installation of integrated audio/video, home theater, smart home automation, lighting control, and security systems for both residential and commercial settings. Services encompass whole-house audio distribution, remote and mobile access for heating, security, and lighting, and coordination with new construction or renovation projects. The company operates from a post office box in Stowe and does not disclose facility size or headcount.

Vermont Electronics serves homeowners, builders, and commercial clients throughout Vermont. Its projects range from custom movie theater rooms and whole-house audio in private residences to smart automation and security installations in office environments. The company emphasizes collaboration with clients during new builds or remodels to embed technology seamlessly.

The company states its differentiation lies in excellence in planning, installation, technical knowledge, and customer service, backed by decades of cumulative technology experience. It positions itself as a local provider offering personalized digital lifestyle solutions rather than a product manufacturer.

name: Vermont Made Furniture Handcrafted by Thurston
old_description: Since 1960, our Vermont family-owned and operated company has passionately crafted exquisite heirloom furniture. We are proud to share this tradition of workmanship and sustainability with you.
about:
Vermont Made Furniture Handcrafted by Thurston operates from a workshop in Brandon, Vermont. The company was founded in 1960 and remains family-owned and operated, now in its third generation of Thurston family leadership. What began as a local woodworking enterprise has grown into a direct-to-consumer maker of heirloom-quality solid wood furniture.

The company designs and builds bedroom, dining, office, and bath furniture from sustainably harvested North American hardwoods — primarily cherry, oak, walnut, and maple. Production runs from rough milling through finishing in their Vermont factory, with each piece made to order. Collections such as Amesbury, Manchester, Weybridge-Dover, Addison, Allen, Chelsea, and Armstrong span mid-century, Shaker, mission, and contemporary styles. Customers select wood species and configurations through a custom-order process; no inventory is held for immediate shipment.

The primary market is residential buyers furnishing homes across the United States. The company sells directly to consumers via its website, eliminating middlemen. It has served over 1,000 homes, shipping nationwide with free white-glove delivery on orders above $5,000.

Thurston emphasizes a lifetime guarantee on every piece, sustainable sourcing from well-managed forests, environmentally friendly finishes, and an energy-efficient workshop. The firm highlights its commitment to local employment — paying living wages to Vermont craftspeople in a safe workplace — and to reducing carbon emissions by manufacturing domestically rather than importing.

name: Vermont Plastic Specialties, Inc.
old_description: Our business approach has focused on meeting the fabrication needs of customers. Since 1982, we have crafted solutions to their product specifications and manufacturing requirements. Our technical expertise is unsurpassed; our plastics inventory is one of the largest in the Northeast.
about:
Vermont Plastic Specialties, Inc. was founded in 1982 in Williston, Vermont. The company operates as a plastics fabrication and material supply business serving commercial and industrial customers across the Northeast.

The shop provides precision laser cutting, waterjet cutting, CNC routing, and custom fabrication for plastic, metal, and wood components. Its equipment includes a 4' x 8' waterjet, two lasers (4' x 4' and 4' x 8'), a 4' x 8' CNC router, a horizontal panel saw capable of 10' x 10' sheets, and a diamond edge finisher for acrylic polishing. The company also maintains a large plastics inventory in thicknesses from 0.03 to 1 inch and offers material sales alongside fabrication services.

Customers include aerospace and industrial firms such as B.F. Goodrich, technology manufacturers like IBM Corporation, and construction-related businesses such as Engelberth Corporation. The company works with clients on projects ranging from museum-quality covers to point-of-purchase displays, providing free estimating and in-house consulting to solve application challenges.

The business was built on a focus on meeting customer fabrication requirements, emphasizing technical expertise and one of the largest plastics inventories in the Northeast. Management highlights its forceless laser cutting process, which eliminates tool contact and fixturing, as a key differentiator for delicate or complex parts.

name: Vesco Medical
old_description: ISO Certified & FDA Registered products made without natural rubber latex, DEHP, BPA or other phthalates plasticizers.
about:
Vesco Medical operates from New Albany, Ohio, in the Columbus metropolitan area. The company does not publicly state its founding year or ownership structure. Its leadership team includes President & CEO Tom Hancock, VP Global Business Development Derek O'Hara, VP Product Development & Innovation Dan Chirayath, Director of Operations & HR Michele Faith, VP of Sales Brian Grant, Director of Quality & Regulatory Assurance Garrett Noble, Controller Trisha Newcome, and National Accounts Director Steve Atkinson.

The company designs and manufactures enteral feeding devices, including feeding pumps with touch-screen controls, medicine bottle adapters in eight sizes, and a range of tube-feeding accessories. All products use ENFit connectors and are produced under an ISO 13485 certified quality management system with FDA 510(k) premarket clearance. The devices are made without natural rubber latex, DEHP, BPA, or other phthalate plasticizers. Vesco Medical does not disclose facility size, headcount, or production volumes.

Vesco Medical serves the medical device and healthcare industries, specifically enteral nutrition for patients from infants to aging adults. Its customers include hospitals, home-care providers, and distributors; the company ships directly or through distribution partners. It is a member of the Global Enteral Device Supplier Association (GEDSA), which promotes international safety standards for tubing connectors.

Vesco Medical positions itself as the only enteral feeding device company that is exclusively ENFit-compliant, a differentiator it says reduces the risk of tubing misconnections. Its stated mission is to advance the quality of care and patient safety for those whose ability to consume nutrition is compromised. The company emphasizes continuous improvement through its ISO 13485 system, FDA good manufacturing practices, and 510(k) clearance.

name: Vestis
old_description: We're in your neighborhood. We're here to support your business.
about:
Vestis operates a service location in Seaford, Delaware, at 56 N. Pine St Extended, providing rental uniforms and workplace supplies to businesses in the surrounding area. The facility is part of the national Vestis network and serves customers with a local team of route sales representatives.

The Seaford branch offers a full-service uniform rental program that delivers fresh, clean workwear weekly, including shirts, pants, outerwear, high-visibility and flame-resistant garments tailored for automotive, manufacturing, and healthcare settings. It also manages floor mat programs with carpeted, scraper, anti-fatigue, and logo mats; restroom supply services with touch-free dispensers, soap, sanitizer, and paper products; first aid cabinet inspections and restocking to meet ANSI recommendations; towel laundering and delivery for glass, bar, dish, microfiber, and shop towels; mop cleaning and delivery for dust, wet, and microfiber mops; and linen laundering for tablecloths and napkins using an EPA-registered disinfectant.

The location serves industries such as automotive, manufacturing, and healthcare, as well as hospitality and food-service businesses that need table linens. Customer reviews reference clients like EMT Automotive and highlight the reliability of route representatives Nelson and Dan.

Vestis positions its Seaford operation as a one-stop shop for workplace supplies, aiming to help brands gain recognition, improve customer experiences, and create safer workplaces through managed rental programs that handle laundering, inventory, and compliance.

about:
Veteran Wood Co. operates from Fairfield in Morris County, New Jersey, as a veteran-owned business founded by Michael, a Marine veteran. The company began with a focus on craftsmanship and dedication, producing handcrafted custom products for homes and offices.

The shop produces custom 3D signs, artistic woodwork, and cabinetry through two sub-brands: Royal Oak Designs for custom cabinetry and Shift Haus Signs for automotive signage. Capabilities include LED channel letters, large-format exterior signs, memorial artwork, and CNC machining using Stepcraft equipment. The company also offers paid training sessions in Vetric design software and Stepcraft CNC operation.

Clients span government and military agencies — including the U.S. Marshals Service, NSA headquarters, Marine Corps bases, and U.S. Capitol Police — as well as veterans organizations such as the VFW, cannabis dispensaries, salons, and general commercial businesses. Projects have ranged from office badge signs and base signage to memorial pieces and retail storefronts.

The company emphasizes its veteran-owned status and American-made production, offering worldwide shipping that includes APO and DPO military addresses. Standard lead times run six to eight weeks, with rush service available for a fee.
